title: Variants of Content — footnote markers
note: n:m join between Table V's cases and table-v-content.json's ids: pp. 98-99 print a trailing '*' (a footnote-reference marker; the footnote text itself isn't present in Table V) after a closing/attainment clause on some cases' own occurrence of that clause but not others' -- e.g. case 10's use of '0(2)' is unmarked, but case 14's reuse of the very same id is starred. Only occurrences that carry the asterisk are listed here; any (case_id, content_id) pair absent from this list prints unstarred.
